title: ご当地鍋の料理
subject_en: Japanese hot pot dishes, each ONE simmering pot (clay donabe or iron pot) with ingredients visible and light steam Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
lead: もつ鍋・すき焼き・水炊き・石狩鍋など、日本各地の鍋料理12点です。冬のメニューや献立の資料に使えます。
items: a pot of motsunabe with beef tripe, cabbage, chives and garlic slices in a clear broth
an iron pan of sukiyaki with thin beef, tofu, leek and shirataki with a raw egg dish beside it
a shallow pot with sliced pork and vegetables, chopsticks lifting a thin slice
a clay pot of chicken mizutaki with cabbage and mushrooms and a ponzu dip
a large pot with chicken meatballs, daikon, leek and fried tofu
a miso pot with salmon, potato, tofu and a pat of butter
a pot with grilled kiritanpo rice sticks, burdock, chicken and greens
a pot of flat hoto noodles with pumpkin and vegetables in miso soup
a pot with plump oysters, tofu and leek in a pale miso broth
a colourful pot with shrimp, fish, chicken, cabbage and mushrooms
a small clay pot with tofu cubes in kombu broth with a ladle and dip dish
a red spicy pot with pork, kimchi, tofu and leek
